For one of our clients, a company specialising in the petrochemical sector and located in the centre of Brussels, we are looking for a Customer Service Officer. 

As a Customer Service Officier you will be responsible for the management of daily operations in the Customer Service Department and work closely together with 2 Sales Representatives. In general he/she is the interface for the different services within the organization and will specialized for commercial and marketing topics.

Your responsibilities as a Customer Service Officer :

Customers :* Handle requests and claims from customers by phone and by email;* Contracts & files : check input, rebates & additional services contracts;* Follow-up marketing actions decided by the Benelux Country Manager;* Order of new customer cards and toll box;* Follow-up portfolio of customers;* Help train the customers to use autonomously extranet, customer portal etc.

General administration :* Mails (post) and the e-mails on the general mailbox;* Sales support for the sales representatives : invoice, edit credit notes, etc;* Reporting activities;* Back-up of colleagues (customer service, sales officer).

Network :* Administrative help to Technical Manager;* Manual acceptance authorization;* Follow up of fraud cases in stations;* Resolve and help customers on issues related to cards and tolls.

The ideal profile of a Customer Service Officer :* You have a perfect command of Dutch, both spoken and written. You also have a very good knowledge of French, both spoken and written. Knowledge of English is an asset.* You have initial experience in Customer Service, Customer Care or file management.* You have a good knowledge of IT tools (MS Office) and are familiar with CRM systems.* You are an organised person, you are willing to take initiative and you have good customer relations skills.* You can easily switch between different tasks and have strong communication skills.

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Harelbeke site, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician in night shift As a maintenance technician, you are passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these findings accurately, allowing us to act proactively and minimise unplanned downtime. 
 
• You perform scheduled maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
 
• You work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
 
• You provide external employees with the necessary support and follow-up to make their contribution effective and efficient. You also supervise technical trainees and new employees to help them grow in their roles. 
 
• You keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo). 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in night shift

For this project, we are looking for a motivated  and experienced laboratory technician who combines solid lab skills with outstanding rigour, organisation and data-handling skills. You will work closely with the project’s postdoctoral researchers and consortium partners, running the assays that test whether our molecules make target proteins misfold during translation, and following up on hits in cells.
Responsibilities:

• Molecular biology: cloning, SDS-PAGE, western blotting, native PAGE
• Running, optimising and miniaturising assays (96/384-well), and supporting their transfer to our high-throughput screening partner
• Medium- to high-throughput screening of compounds and peptides, including plate design, controls, dose-response series and counter-screens
• Mammalian cell culture and cell-based hit validation: high-content imaging, degradation and dose-response assays
• Compound-protein binding studies (BLI, SPR, MST, fluorescence polarisation) 
• Compound and sample management: inventories, plate maps, sample tracking and shipments to partners
• Meticulous electronic lab notebook documentation, writing and maintaining SOPs, and structured, well-annotated data storage and analysis in line with the project’s data management plan
• Planning and tracking experiments against project milestones and deliverables, and contributing to the day-to-day running of the lab (ordering, stock management, equipment)
• Contributing to the interpretation of results, literature reviews and preparation of figures, methods sections and technical contributions to publications and reports.
• Acting as a technical reference point for project members, helping train new researchers and ensuring continuity of technical know-how across the consortium.

• A Bachelor in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biomedical Sciences or similar, or equivalent by experience
• Essential: Experience with core molecular biology and protein biochemistry techniques 
• Essential: Experience with mammalian cell culture and high-content imaging
• Essential: Experience with plate-based assays (luminescence/fluorescence), multichannel pipetting or liquid-handling automation to achieve high throughput
• Essential: Experience with electronic lab notebooks/LIMS, Excel and data analysis software
• Essential: Demonstrated ability to independently plan, execute and optimise experimental workflows and make technical decisions within agreed project objectives
• Essential: Fluent in English (oral and written); knowledge of Dutch is an asset
• Advantageous: Experience with in vitro translation, flow cytometry, protein purification or biophysical techniques
• Advantageous: Experience in training, mentoring or onboarding students or colleaguesCompetencies:
• Organisation and rigour: you work accurately and reproducibly, maintain excellent records and keep track of multiple experiments, samples, compounds and project deadlines. 
• Communication and teamwork: you communicate clearly and proactively, work effectively with colleagues and external partners, and are comfortable working both independently and within a multidisciplinary team. 
• Problem solving: you troubleshoot critically and propose practical solutions. 
• Discretion and motivation: you handle confidential and IP-sensitive information appropriately and have a genuine interest in drug discovery and translational science.

Satellit seeks a Business Analyst to support the digital upgrade of physical assets with an emphasis on enabling remote servicing and condition-based upkeep. The role involves eliciting and formalizing business needs, redesigning operational workflows, specifying requirements for supporting IT systems, coordinating between operational teams and technical implementers, ensuring data integrity and migrations, validating releases through testing, and leading user adoption activities. The technical scope covers Industrial IoT, machine-to-machine communications, large-scale data processing and AI techniques as applied to maintenance of high-voltage electrical equipment.
Who are you?

Skills & competences:

• requirements elicitation and specification

• change management methodology

• business process modeling

• customer orientation and flexibility

• training material development and delivery

• stakeholder management and alignment

• data migration coordination

• knowledge of IoT technologies

• effective and assertive communication

• test planning and validation

• context diagram and business domain modelling

• impact analysis

• writing user stories and use cases

• knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) concepts

• data quality management

• analytical thinking and problem solving

• Dutch, English and French

• experience with industrial asset maintenance concepts

• planning and organisation

Preferred qualifications:

• Master's degree in a technical discipline or equivalent professional experience.

• At least 5 years of hands-on experience gathering and describing business requirements.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in analysing and modelling business processes.

What will you do?

• MAP current processes and work with stakeholders to redesign workflows that enable remote operations and predictive maintenance approaches.

• Perform impact assessments to reveal downstream effects of proposed changes on systems, procedures and stakeholder roles.

• Create contextual diagrams, domain models and user-focused scenarios; translate business objectives into clear requirements and usage guidelines for IT solutions.

• Mediate between operational teams and IT to reconcile differing expectations; coordinate the review and validation of functional analyses.

• Contribute to data governance efforts and oversee migration activities to ensure data completeness and correctness during transitions.

• Develop and run test plans to verify implemented changes and document validation results.

• Plan and deliver change activities including development of training materials, conducting end-user sessions and providing post-rollout support.

Understanding exactly what a customer needs is essential. Do you believe listening is just as important as speaking? Then keep reading!
 

A selection of your responsibilities:
 

 
• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
 
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
 
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
 
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
 
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.

We are looking for the following profile:
 

 
• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
 
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.
 
• You are confident handling a high volume of telephone calls and emails while maintaining accuracy and service quality.
 
• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
 
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
 
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
 
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
 
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
 
• You are available for a full-time position.

Lead the technical evolution of a modern cloud platform, combining .NET development, software architecture, AI-assisted engineering, and technical leadership.

Our partner is a technology-driven organization investing heavily in cloud-native development, AI-assisted software engineering, and modern platform architecture.

As part of a growing engineering team, they are looking for a Senior Developer / Tech Lead who can combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities.

This role goes far beyond pure development. You'll influence architectural decisions, mentor developers, drive engineering excellence, and help shape the future of an AI-native software delivery environment where AI agents actively support coding, testing, and refactoring activities.
Senior Tech Lead | The Role
• Design, build, and enhance scalable applications using .NET, C# and Microsoft Azure.
• Transform business requirements into robust technical solutions, architectures, and implementation plans.
• Establish and promote high engineering standards through code reviews, mentoring, and technical coaching.
• Work alongside AI-powered development tools to accelerate delivery while ensuring the quality, security, and maintainability of the resulting software.
• Drive architectural decisions and contribute to the evolution of cloud-native and event-driven systems.
• Identify opportunities to improve development practices, platform performance, delivery processes, and technical solutions.
Senior Tech Lead | The Profile
• You bring extensive experience in .NET / C# software development, ideally within complex enterprise environments.
• You have strong expertise with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based architectures.
• You are comfortable working with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• You have experience with Angular or modern front-end development frameworks.
• You regularly leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions and understand both their strengths and limitations.
• You have a proven ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, challenge architectural decisions, and drive software quality across a development team.
• Complete proficiency in Dutch, English and French
 

Nice to Have

• Experience with Event-Driven Architecture, messaging systems, and asynchronous integrations.
• Exposure to GraphQL, PostgreSQL, or document-oriented data management.
• Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and scalable software design practices.
• Experience with event sourcing patterns and distributed applications.
• Familiarity with modern search and analytics technologies.
• Microsoft Azure or DevOps certifications are considered a plus.
